row: At IPRC we provide our patients a life with NO MORE PAIN. We treat our patients with personalized care according to need to each patient. Our priority is to treat the root cause of pain. We provide the treatment with the state-of-the-art equipment. TeamIPRC is highly professional, having good hands and excellent minds to treat their patients. We treat our patients not only with best equipment but also with high manual skills
